{"Author":"NightmareXIV","Name":"Splatoon","Punchline":"Scriptable overlay engine for drawing mechanics, markers, and indicators in real-time","Description":"Splatoon is a scriptable telegraph and overlay engine for Final Fantasy XIV, built on the Dalamud plugin framework. {"Author":"Faye, Kage","Name":"Better Occult Crescent & Chest Helper Interface","InternalName":"BOCCHI","Punchline":"BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.","Description":"BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.

- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: bocchi (alias: och)
  /bocchi → Opens the main window
  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /bocchi config list → Lists config keys
  /bocchi config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /bocchi buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /bocchi (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)

Needs a language pack.","Description":"Gubal Library hands the game pre-translated copies of its own text files, so the game draws another language itself, in its own font and its own layout. Your game installation is never modified.

It ships empty and belongs to no language: point it at a community language pack and the game speaks that language. You choose what gets translated and what stays English, part by part.

/gubal → Opens the settings window.
/gubal status → What is installed, what is being served, and whether it reached the game.
/gubal parts → Lists what the pack covers and what you have switched off.
/gubal check → Asks the publisher whether a newer pack exists.
/gubal usepack → Serves the installed pack, or stops serving it.
/gubal autoupdate → Fetches a newer pack while the game is starting.
/gubal debug on|off → Diagnostics for when a page or a font is not reaching the game.

A pack must match the patch you are running, and the game reads its text once at startup, so a change takes effect the next time you start the client.

Optional dialogue links open unlocked Unending Codex entries directly from NPC dialogue and cutscenes. Enable them in /gubal.
